limitations: Full radius is complete only for known routable settlement points of the archived matrix.
A regional sample without nonself peers forms a labelled singleton, not a proved external service centre.
External comparisons are censored when the known external frame begins within h.
The half-time is a field/comparison scale, not a maximum whole-basin travel time.
Population basins still require independent functional and geographic validation.
Administrative service documents are selected controls, not a representative province-wide travel sample.
Co-location can become trivial in a single large basin; between-document pair errors, ARI and null expectations are reported.
The functional and population models share transport geography; functional locality is not independent evidence of trips.
A destination outside the regional membership axis is censored, not automatically outside the complete spatial system.
School enrichment reused its document; medical matching concerns NP destinations across source dates, not buildings, capacity or observed choice.

interpretation_limits: The document sample is a selected rural service-control cohort, not the population from which an oblast settlement-system typology can be inferred.
Partial organisation workers are not resident employed people or complete jobs; their host-NP population coverage is not worker coverage.
Municipal output and sector statistics stay municipal; associations do not allocate them to villages or establish causality.
Published NP type, numerical population size, transport position and functional system rank are distinct.
Matched reported record values do not prove unchanged historic boundaries.

limitations: Regional halo exit is censored, not an external peak or proved isolation.
Neighbour graph and h-limited graph are sensitivity choices, not established settlement-system boundaries.
Strict ascent only; numerically flat and zero-time comparisons stay explicitly ambiguous.
Summed comparison-edge times are neither a shortest whole trip nor a service travel budget.
Scale-local edges can chain beyond h; large basins are not validated service areas.
Documented functional centres survive separately even when not population maxima.

claim: Population concentration scenarios and external checks; no final functional settlement systems established.
